scope: /Users/1millnonstop/Downloads/web/ — 17 files, 4 viewports (mobile 360 / tablet 768 / desktop 1280 / wide 1920), WCAG 2.1 AA, FR market legal completeness
executive_summary: WCAG 2.1 AA: prior Z-7 cycle landed axe-core clean (0 critical / 0 serious × 4 viewports × 4 pages = 16 reports), heals applied for button-name P0 (cart close, trash, +/-, burger aria-expanded). Coherent 4-viewport responsive behavior with .lc-show-mobile / .lc-hide-mobile primitives + 4-col grid → 1-col mobile via styles-mobile.css. Critical NEW finding: **5 legal pages contain 29 'À COMPLÉTER' placeholders** (13 in mentions.html alone) covering SIREN, SIRET, RCS, TVA intracom, capital social, directeur de la publication, hébergeur identity. For 'FINAL V1 production-prep' on the French market this is **LCEN art. 6 III non-compliance** — site is technically online but identity disclosure is incomplete. Cannot heal without owner business data. Other a11y observations: focus-visible styling unverified (no :focus-visible audit), Esc-key not bound for modal close (P3), language switcher absent (acceptable — FR only V1), no skip-link to main content (P2). Funnel error states (promo-invalid, validation) have role='alert' aria-live='assertive' (P0 heal already landed).

findings.title: 5 legal pages contain 29 'À COMPLÉTER' placeholders — LCEN art. 6 III non-compliance for V1 production
where: /Users/1millnonstop/Downloads/web/legal/mentions.html — 13 placeholders (SIREN, SIRET, RCS, TVA intracom, capital social, directeur de la publication, raison sociale, forme juridique, code APE/NAF, hébergeur nom, hébergeur adresse, hébergeur téléphone, hébergeur site web)
findings.description: Loi 2004-575 du 21 juin 2004 (LCEN) article 6 III requires editor identity disclosure on any website with a publication director. Article R10-1 du Code de la consommation requires vendor identification for online commerce. The legal pages have correct STRUCTURE (h1, breadcrumb, cross-refs, footer) but display literal '[À COMPLÉTER PAR PROPRIÉTAIRE — ...]' text where SIREN, SIRET, RCS, TVA intracom, hosting provider name, etc. should appear. A customer reading mentions.html sees raw template text — this is worse than 'page missing' because it announces unfinished compliance.
findings.evidence: grep -c 'COMPLÉTER' /Users/1millnonstop/Downloads/web/legal/*.html → mentions.html:13, privacy.html:7, cgv.html:4, cookies.html:4, allergens.html:1 = 29 total. Sample line mentions.html:62 'SIREN : [À COMPLÉTER PAR PROPRIÉTAIRE — 9 chiffres]'
findings.impact: Compliance: LCEN penalty up to 75k€ + 1y prison for editor (rarely enforced for SME but legally exposed). CGV non-compliance opens 14-day rétractation rule disputes. Consumer trust: customer reading 'À COMPLÉTER' loses confidence at purchase moment. SEO: search engines may flag placeholder content.
findings.recommendation: OWNER GATE G-WEB-LEGAL-1: owner provides 9 business identity values (SIREN / SIRET / RCS / TVA / capital / directeur / raison / forme juridique / code APE) + hosting provider info. Replace placeholders via simple sed/Edit. Until then BLOCKING for V1 production launch. Cannot heal in this audit — no owner data available.

findings.title: No skip-link to main content (WCAG 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks)
findings.description: Standard a11y pattern: first focusable element should be 'Aller au contenu principal' link that jumps past nav. Keyboard-only users currently must tab through all 5 nav links + cart + account on every page. Mobile has the same issue (drawer adds more focusable elements).
findings.evidence:
index.html lines 17-18: '\n
'. No skip-link.
findings.impact: WCAG 2.4.1 Level A failure technically — minor in practice (nav is short) but pattern missing.
findings.recommendation: V1.x backlog: add absolutely-positioned visually-hidden-until-focused 'Passer au contenu' link. ~5 LOC + 1 CSS class.

findings.title: Esc-key not bound for modal/drawer close (WCAG 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap partial)
findings.where: components.jsx:151 WebModal + flows.jsx:8 CartDrawer + account-v2.jsx + wizard-v2.jsx + screens-v3.jsx ItemDetailModal
findings.description: All 5 modal/drawer surfaces close on backdrop-click + X-button. Esc-key not wired. Per WAI-ARIA dialog pattern, modals SHOULD trap focus AND respond to Escape. Current state: focus can escape modal via Tab (not strictly trapped), Escape does nothing.
findings.evidence: No occurrence of 'Escape' or 'keydown' in any web .jsx file.
findings.impact: Power-user UX gap, partial WCAG dialog pattern. Not user-blocking on touch devices.
findings.recommendation: V1.x backlog: useEffect listener in WebModal + CartDrawer for keydown Escape → onClose. ~10 LOC each, ≤30 LOC total.

findings.title: Tab pattern (rewards/history/how/profile in WebLoyalty) lacks role='tablist' + aria-selected
findings.description: Three places use .lc-cat-tabs as tab UI: WebLoyalty (4 tabs rewards/history/how/profile), WebMenu (category chips mobile), OrdersPage (Tout/Livrées/Annulées). HTML markup is button.lc-cat-tab with is-on class — no role='tablist' on container, no role='tab' on buttons, no aria-selected. Screen readers announce 'Récompenses, button' not 'Récompenses, tab 1 of 4, selected'.
findings.evidence: screens.jsx:661-665, no ARIA tab attributes. Listed in prior Z-7 cycle deferred backlog (Tab ARIA polish P2).
findings.impact: Screen-reader UX gap. Tab pattern WCAG 4.1.2 Name/Role/Value partial.
findings.recommendation: V1.x backlog (already deferred prior cycle): refactor to <div role='tablist'> + <button role='tab' aria-selected={...} aria-controls={...}>. ~15 LOC × 3 places = ~45 LOC. Deferred V1.x acceptable since prior cycle owner-accepted.

findings.title: Footer phone/email/address buttons not <a href> — non-semantic + no click action
findings.description: Footer 'Contact' section uses <button> wrappers around phone '06 51 30 XX XX', email 'contact@lecayenne.fr', address, hours — but no onClick handlers. tel: and mailto: hrefs should be <a> for mobile tap-to-call and tap-to-email UX.
findings.impact: Mobile UX: customer cannot tap to call/email. SEO: structured data hint missing. A11y: button without action confuses keyboard nav.
findings.recommendation: P1 candidate for V1 launch polish (≤15 LOC): swap <button> to <a href='tel:0651300000'> / <a href='mailto:contact@lecayenne.fr'> / <a href='https://maps.google.com/?q=...' rel='noopener'>. Could heal in this cycle if owner OKs (≤10 LOC, no business data needed) — but defer until owner reviews mid-cycle.

findings.where: Multiple — components.jsx:122, screens.jsx:305, legal/mentions.html:68, legal/mentions.html:142, legal/cgv.html:61
findings.description: Phone '06 51 30 XX XX' (with literal XX XX masked digits) and 'contact@lecayenne.fr' appear in footer + about + legal pages. findings.title: Pickup calendar buttons (Jour AUJ/JEU/...) lack aria-label per date
findings.description: Day buttons render '<button>{d.d}/{d.n}</button>' → 'AUJ 14' visually. Screen reader announces 'AUJ 14, button' — no semantic 'aujourd'hui jeudi 14 mai 2026'. Same pattern slot buttons line 166 ('Dans 20 min 19h45' read correctly as buttons but no date context).
findings.evidence: funnel.jsx:153 const days = [{ id: 'today', d: 'AUJ', n: '14' }, ...]
findings.impact: Screen-reader UX during pickup time selection. Listed in prior Z-7 P2 backlog.
findings.recommendation: V1.x backlog (deferred prior cycle): add aria-label={`${d.d}, ${d.n} mai`}. ~5 LOC.
